topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: It’s been a while since I've heard from Jessica, one of my former students. Imagine my surprise when I found a beautifully wrapped package on my doorstep, adorned with a simple card that read, "To my favorite teacher, from your not-so-secret admirer." Inside was a custom-made bookmark, vibrant with colors and crafted with such delicate care. Along with it, there was a note expressing gratitude for the encouragement and support I provided during her tough times. Every word reminded me of why I love teaching—not just for the lessons I impart, but for the connections we make. I can’t wait to use the bookmark in my favorite book. It’s small gestures like these that remind me of the impact we can have on each other’s lives.
